scenario_description: Elena has begun traveling by bus to a morning assignment at Indianola K-8 School when a water-main break forces everyone off her bus and suspends service along the rest of her route. Her active trip is blocked at North High Street and Hudson Street. A separate message then reveals that coworker Jordan Patel is about to drive from a nearby business to Indianola with a free passenger seat. At event4, the need is sufficiently observable by connecting Elena's stranded location, Jordan's route and departure time, and the school destination; proactive help can prepare an immediate pickup request with the exact meeting point. Later events add the check-in deadline and confirm that waiting for another bus will not get Elena to school in time.

parameter.subject: August 6 substitute assignment at Indianola
parameter.body: Your substitute assignment is confirmed at Indianola K-8 School, 420 E 19th Avenue, for Thursday, August 6, 2026. Please check in at the main office by 7:35 AM. Your classroom coverage begins at 7:45 AM.

parameter.content: I am aboard the southbound Route 2 bus to Indianola now. We just left the North Broadway stop, and the schedule still has me reaching the school around 7:20.

The driver ended the trip because of a water-main break ahead, and all passengers had to get off. I am standing by the southeast corner of North High Street and Hudson Street with my laptop and classroom kit. The bus cannot continue toward Indianola.

I am at Clintonville Copy and Supply, 2864 N High Street, and will leave at 7:15 to drive to Indianola for my morning shift. I have a free passenger seat and can collect someone along North High if I hear from them before I pull out.

parameter.subject: Morning check-in timing
parameter.body: The assigned teacher's class enters at 7:45 AM today. Please reach the main office by 7:35 AM so staff can issue the room key and give you the attendance folder. If you will miss that check-in time, contact the office immediately so another staff member can supervise the arriving students.

parameter.subject: Route 2 interruption at North High and Hudson
parameter.body: Because of the emergency water-main closure, southbound Route 2 buses are not serving stops between Hudson Street and 17th Avenue. No replacement bus is expected at North High Street and Hudson Street before 8:05 AM. Riders should use alternate transportation until the closure is cleared.

parameter.name: Jordan Patel
parameter.notes: Instructional aide who sometimes drives from Clintonville to Indianola.
